subject: general
question: World Homoeopathy Day is observed every year on 10 April to pay tribute to the founder and father of the Homeopathy system of medicine, Dr. Christian Friedrich Samuel Hahnemann. What is its theme for 2025?

options.text: Enhancing the scope of Homoeopathy in Public Health

solution:
The correct answer is __**Study, Teaching, Research**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **World Homoeopathy Day** is observed every year on **10 April **to pay **tribute to the founder and father** of the Homeopathy system of medicine** Dr. Christian Friedrich Samuel Hahnemann**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The day aims to **spread knowledge about Homeopathic medicine** in public health.
 
• **World Homeopathy Week** is celebrated annually from** 10 April to 16 April**.
 
• The **theme of 2025 is “**Study, Teaching, Research**”**.
 
• India, with 3.45 lakh registered homoeopathy doctors and over 277 hospitals, will host the largest symposium in **Gandhinagar, Gujarat, in 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Samuel Hahnemann** held that in order to treat a patient's sickness, the **ingredients that cause the disease's symptoms** must be administered.

 
 
• Thus, **homeopathy **works on the principle of **“like cures **like”
